section_summary.extract_value: This section reports one validation study (Study X) of the BAS-2 in Brazilian adolescents (N = 840; 438 boys, 402 girls; mean ages ≈15.5). Confirmatory factor analysis supported a unidimensional and partially invariant factor structure across gender and weight status; the BAS-2 showed adequate internal consistency and two-week temporal stability, and body appreciation was negatively associated with BMI in both boys and girls.
